subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this bundled report be split into separate owner-scoped fixes for CLI/TUI routing, channel session lineage, internal-event backpressure, and session-activity sorting, or should one canonical redesign own them together?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the remaining behavior crosses core Gateway, TUI, external WeChat plugin ownership, cron/subagent routing, and session UI semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Split by owner
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, create or link narrower canonical items for each surface, and close duplicated subparts only after focused source/live proof.

options.title: One session-routing project
options.body: Assign a single maintainer-owned redesign covering session identity, lineage, event priority, and activity semantics before implementation.

options.title: Close partial fixes only
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly accept the remaining behavior as covered by existing open items and no umbrella tracking is needed.

recommendation.title: Split by owner
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, create or link narrower canonical items for each surface, and close duplicated subparts only after focused source/live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the broadest recent history across gateway session rows, session activity state, session controls, and WeChat documentation among the inspected paths.
